# One Chuan Grove Guide

> Independent, sourced guide to One Chuan Grove, a 99-year leasehold condominium of about 1,056 homes at Chuan Grove, off Lorong Chuan, District 19, Singapore. Developer: Chuan Grove Pte Ltd (Sing Holdings Residential 65%, Sunway Developments 35%). Expected launch February 2027. No price list released as of 14 November 2026. Written by Jack Leow, CEA Reg. R074023I, PropNex Realty Pte Ltd (Licence L3008022J).

Each fact is labelled Confirmed (URA, LTA, SGX/Bursa filings, major press), Reported (preliminary or third-party, may change) or Estimate.

## Key facts
- Name: One Chuan Grove [Confirmed]
- Developer: Chuan Grove Pte Ltd (Sing Holdings Residential 65%, Sunway Developments 35%) [Confirmed]
- Tenure: 99-year leasehold [Confirmed]
- Location: Chuan Grove, off Lorong Chuan, District 19, OCR [Confirmed]
- Parcel 1: 170,409 sq ft; $703.60m; $1,376 psf ppr; 7 bids; tender closed 8 Jul 2025 [Confirmed]
- Parcel 1 award: Awarded 17 Jul 2025 [Confirmed]
- Parcel 2: 156,231 sq ft; GFA 468,693 sq ft; $623.91m; $1,331 psf ppr; 5 bids; awarded 10 Sep 2025 [Confirmed]
- Combined GFA: 979,924 sq ft; in-principle amalgamation approval; construction from 2H 2026 [Confirmed]
- Blended land rate: $1,355 psf ppr (our division of total price by GFA) [Estimate]
- Homes: 1,056 apartments; one 24-storey and four 27-storey blocks [Confirmed]
- Expected launch: February 2027 (Huttons, via EdgeProp) [Confirmed]
- Preview / booking: 13 Feb / 27 Feb 2027 (developer preliminary information as reported) [Reported]
- Unit sizes: 474 – 1,561 sq ft; shops 409 sq ft [Confirmed]
- Other uses: 7 shops, 1 childcare centre [Confirmed]
- Unit mix: 1BR 3 · 2BR 471 · 3BR 315 · 4BR 240 · 5BR 27 [Reported]
- Facilities (partial): 1,300 sq ft gym, 2 golf simulators, indoor air-conditioned badminton/pickleball court; 5BR with private lift; childcare ≈10,000 sq ft [Reported]
- Type codes: 18 estimated codes in PropNex OCG Insider's Guide 1.2 (as of 5 Nov 2026), subject to authority approval: 3BR 54×807, 78×840, 78×893 sq ft; 2BR Premium 646 sq ft split 54 and 155; 4BR luxury private lift 1,356 sq ft split 54 and 27. Counts still sum to 1,056. Not official floor plans. [Reported]
- Layouts: 11 layouts: 2BR 48 / Premium 209 / Premium+Study 214; 3BR 210 / Premium 24 / Premium+Flexi 81; 4BR 51 / Premium 108 / Luxury 81; 5BR Luxury 27; 1BR 3 [Reported]
- Facilities (full list): 50 m lap pool, spa and relaxation pools, hot/cold baths, steam room, tennis, 2 padel, outdoor pickleball, indoor badminton/pickleball, 2 golf simulators, 1,300 sq ft gym, Pilates and yoga studios, 800 m jogging path, 2 private dining rooms, 4 gourmet pavilions [Reported]
- Car park: About 800 lots [Reported]
- Showflat: Youngberg Terrace, near Woodleigh MRT (one marketing source). PropNex OCG Insider's Guide 1.2 (5 Nov 2026) says the showflat is not on the actual site and only dates the preview as February 2027; it does not name the street or 13 and 27 February. [Reported]
- Basement car parks: 2 (reported from project signboard) [Reported]
- Consultants: Architect P&T Consultants; builder Kimly Construction (reported from project signboard) [Reported]
- Expected completion: 16 Jul 2030 (reported from project signboard) [Reported]
- Nearest MRT: Lorong Chuan CC14, within about 400 m [Confirmed]
- Circle Line loop: CCL6 opened 12 Jul 2026 [Confirmed]
- Schools within 1 km: St. Gabriel's, Kuo Chuan Presbyterian, CHIJ OLGC, Yangzheng (reported) [Reported]
- Analyst price range: ≈ $2,600 (PropNex) to $2,800 (SRI) psf; some commentary to $2,850 [Estimate]
- Chuan Park: 916 homes; 76% sold at launch, $2,579 psf; 99% at $2,594 psf by 27 Oct 2026 [Confirmed]
- Thomson Reserve: 1,143 of 1,268 sold, ≈ $2,900 psf, 30–31 Oct 2026 [Confirmed]
- Reserve List site: 31,695.7 sqm; GFA 79,240 sqm; ≈ 930 homes; released 27 Oct 2026 [Confirmed]
- Chuan Park resale: Caveats centred around $2,650–2,700 psf, 12 months to Aug 2026 [Reported]
- Jack's price bands: Good value ≤ $2,650 psf; Fair $2,650–2,800; Stretch > $2,800 (project average) [Estimate]
- Buying through an agent: Same developer list price; developer pays the agent's commission; buyers pay no agent fee [Confirmed]

## Estimated prices (analyst range $2,600–$2,850 psf; not a price list)
- 1 Bedroom: 474 sq ft — est. $1.23m to $1.35m
- 2 Bedroom / 2 Bedroom + Study: 581 – 710 sq ft — est. $1.51m to $2.02m
- 3 Bedroom / 3 Bedroom Flexi: 807 – 1,001 sq ft — est. $2.10m to $2.85m
- 4 Bedroom: 1,076 – 1,356 sq ft — est. $2.80m to $3.86m
- 5 Bedroom: 1,561 sq ft — est. $4.06m to $4.45m

## Common errors elsewhere
- The nearest MRT is Lorong Chuan (CC14) on the Circle Line, not a Cross Island Line station.
- The developer is a Sing Holdings–Sunway joint venture, not Sing Holdings alone.
- Some marketing guides say a 3-minute walk to Lorong Chuan MRT, and that Botanic Gardens is 4 stops away. The figure used here is about 400 m. Botanic Gardens (CC19) is five Circle Line stops from Lorong Chuan (CC14).
- One Chuan Grove uses Chuan Grove Parcels 1 and 2. The third Chuan Grove site (Reserve List, 27 Oct 2026, ≈930 homes) is separate and unsold.

Jack's verdict so far

A strong own-stay address whose value case depends entirely on the price list.

The location is proven. Chuan Park next door is 99% sold, the Circle Line loop is now complete, and the Serangoon–Bishan school catchment is among the most sought-after in the north-east.

What is not proven is the price. At the analyst range of $2,600 to $2,850 psf, One Chuan Grove would sit at or above Chuan Park, with a third Chuan Grove site of about 930 homes now available for sale nearby. Shortlist it for family own-stay. Wait for the price list before treating it as an investment.

Missed Thomson Reserve?

## The family units sold out first. One Chuan Grove has 555 of them.

Thomson Reserve sold 1,143 of 1,268 homes on its 30–31 October launch. Every 3- and 4-bedroom went. One Chuan Grove has 315 three-bedrooms and 240 four-bedrooms, a larger share of family units than Thomson Reserve had.

## What would make One Chuan Grove good value?

Set before the price list is out, so the verdict can't bend to fit the prices. Jack will publish where the launch lands on the day.

Good value≤ $2,650 psfAt or below what Chuan Park units have changed hands for over the past year, for a project that completes about two years later.

Fair$2,650 – 2,800Up to about 5% above Chuan Park's recent prices. A reasonable premium for newer stock and a larger site.

Stretch> $2,800 psfClose to Thomson Reserve's ≈$2,900 launch average. The upside from here relies on the market rising.

Project-average psf. Smaller units always carry a higher psf, so judge a 2-bedroom against 2-bedrooms. About the project

## What is One Chuan Grove?

One Chuan Grove is a 99-year leasehold condominium of 1,056 homes at Chuan Grove, off Lorong Chuan in District 19, Singapore. It is being developed by Chuan Grove Pte Ltd, a joint venture of Sing Holdings (65%) and Sunway (35%), on two adjacent Government Land Sales parcels bought in 2025 for $1.33 billion and combined into one 326,640 sq ft site.

The Chuan Grove condo has five blocks, one of 24 storeys and four of 27, with 1- to 5-bedroom homes from 474 to 1,561 sq ft, 7 shops and a childcare centre. It is about 400 m from Lorong Chuan MRT on the Circle Line, one stop from the Serangoon and Bishan interchanges. Before it was named in September 2026 it was known as the Chuan Grove GLS site or Chuan Grove Residences.

The showflat preview is planned for 13 February 2027 and booking day for 27 February 2027. No price list has been released; analysts expect an average of $2,600 to $2,850 psf. Completion is expected around 2030.

Set the record straight

## Five things other One Chuan Grove pages get wrong

1The station is Lorong Chuan (CC14)It is on the Circle Line. There is no "Chuan Park MRT" and no Cross Island Line station serving the site.

2The developer is a joint ventureChuan Grove Pte Ltd is 65% Sing Holdings Residential and 35% Sunway Developments.

3There is no price list yetA "direct developer price" or "VVIP discount" offered now cannot be checked against anything.

4"Chuan Grove" now means three parcelsOne Chuan Grove uses two. The third, released on 27 October 2026, is separate and unsold.

5It is not freeholdBoth parcels are 99-year leasehold Government Land Sales sites.

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

All questions

If I walk into the showflat on my own, who serves me?Usually a salesperson from one of the marketing agencies the developer has appointed. You pay the same price either way. The difference is whether the person helping you has looked at the numbers for your situation before you arrive.

Is this the official One Chuan Grove website?No. This is an independent guide by Jack Leow, a CEA-registered property agent (R074023I) with PropNex Realty. The developer's own project page is on singholdings.com. Many sites calling themselves 'official' are run by agents too; check the CEA number in their footer.

Do I pay more if I buy One Chuan Grove through an agent?No. Singapore developers sell new launch units at the same list price whether you go direct or through an agent, and the developer pays the agent's commission. Buyers pay no agent fee.

Can I get a better price going direct to the developer?No. Launch prices and any early-bird discounts are set by the developer and apply to every buyer in that release, whether they come direct or through an agent.

What is One Chuan Grove?One Chuan Grove is a 99-year leasehold condominium of 1,056 homes at Chuan Grove, off Lorong Chuan in District 19, Singapore. It is built on two adjacent Government Land Sales parcels that the developer amalgamated into one site of 326,640 sq ft.

Is One Chuan Grove the same as the Chuan Grove GLS site?Yes, for the two parcels awarded in 2025. One Chuan Grove sits on Chuan Grove Parcel 1 (awarded July 2025) and Parcel 2 (awarded September 2025). It is not the separate 930-unit Chuan Grove Reserve List site URA released on 27 October 2026, which has not been sold.

When does One Chuan Grove launch?The launch is expected in February 2027. Third-party reports of the developer's preliminary plan put the preview on 13 February 2027 and booking day on 27 February 2027. The developer has not published a confirmed date.

How much will One Chuan Grove cost?No price list has been released. Analyst estimates range from about $2,600 to $2,850 psf, which would put a 474 sq ft 1-bedroom at roughly $1.23m to $1.35m and an 807 to 1,001 sq ft 3-bedroom at roughly $2.10m to $2.85m.

Who is the developer of One Chuan Grove?Chuan Grove Pte Ltd, a joint venture owned 65% by Sing Holdings Residential and 35% by Sunway Developments, according to the companies' stock exchange filings.

Which MRT station is nearest to One Chuan Grove?Lorong Chuan MRT (CC14) on the Circle Line, within about 400 m. Serangoon (CC13/NE12) and Bishan (CC15/NS17) interchanges are one stop away in either direction.

# When does One Chuan Grove launch?
URL: https://the-one-chuan-grove.sg/launch-date/

One Chuan Grove is expected to launch in February 2027. The developer's preliminary plan, as reported, puts the showflat preview from 13 February and booking day on 27 February 2027. Neither date has been formally confirmed.

Short answer
Preview from Saturday 13 February 2027, booking day Saturday 27 February 2027. Both dates are reported, not confirmed; Huttons' CEO separately told EdgeProp in October 2026 that the project is planned for a February 2027 launch.

## How a Singapore new launch weekend actually runs

The preview is for viewing the showflat and the price list. You cannot buy during the preview. If you want to book, you submit an expression of interest with a cheque, usually during the preview week. On booking day, buyers are called in the order their ballot numbers came out, and each picks from whatever units are left.

At Thomson Reserve in October 2026, around 3,200 cheques were collected for 1,268 homes. If One Chuan Grove draws similar interest, a late ballot number can leave you with only the stacks nobody else wanted. That is why it pays to rank five or six specific units, not just a unit type, before booking day.

## What to prepare before 13 February 2027

An in-principle loan approval from your bank, so you know your real ceiling.

Your stamp duty position: first home, second home with ABSD, or a sell-first plan. Run the numbers.

Cash or CPF for the 5% option fee on the day, and the next 15% plus stamp duty within the following weeks.

A ranked shortlist of stacks, with a view on which face the CTE and which face the low-rise Chiltern landed estate.

## Questions about the launch
When is the One Chuan Grove launch date?One Chuan Grove is expected to launch in February 2027. Reports of the developer's preliminary plan give a preview from 13 February 2027 and booking day on 27 February 2027. These dates are not yet confirmed by the developer.

When will the One Chuan Grove price list be released?Price lists for Singapore new launches are usually released at or just before the preview. Expect it around the preview in mid-February 2027.

How much is the booking fee for One Chuan Grove?Under Singapore's Progressive Payment Scheme the buyer pays 5% of the price when the Option to Purchase is granted on booking day, then 15% (less the 5%) on exercising the Sale and Purchase Agreement within 8 weeks.

When will One Chuan Grove be completed?Construction started in the second half of 2026. A typical build of about four years points to completion around 2030; project signboard information reported by third parties gives an expected completion date of 16 July 2030.

# How much will One Chuan Grove cost?
URL: https://the-one-chuan-grove.sg/price/

No price list has been released. Working from the $1,355 psf ppr land cost and published analyst views, a reasonable expectation is an average of $2,600 to $2,850 psf, putting a 1-bedroom from about $1.23m and a 3-bedroom from about $2.10m.

Short answer
Expect roughly $2,600 to $2,850 psf on average, until the developer publishes its list. That is an estimate built from the land price and analyst commentary, not a quotation.

## Jack's price bands

Where the launch average lands decides the verdict. These bands are fixed now, before any prices are out.

Good value≤ $2,650 psfAt or below what Chuan Park units have changed hands for over the past year, for a project that completes about two years later.

Fair$2,650 – 2,800Up to about 5% above Chuan Park's recent prices. A reasonable premium for newer stock and a larger site.

Stretch> $2,800 psfClose to Thomson Reserve's ≈$2,900 launch average. The upside from here relies on the market rising.

Project-average psf. Smaller units always carry a higher psf, so judge a 2-bedroom against 2-bedrooms. ## Quantum matters more than psf

Buyers borrow and pay in total dollars. Thomson Reserve's 3-bedrooms were 947 to 1,152 sq ft and started at $2.503m. If One Chuan Grove's 3-bedrooms really are 807 to 1,001 sq ft, a $2,700 psf price would put the smallest at about $2.18m, lower in total than Thomson Reserve's cheapest 3-bedroom despite a similar psf. Smaller layouts can make a higher psf look affordable. Compare usable space, not just the headline rate.

## Why the price may land at the lower end

A third Chuan Grove site of about 930 homes is now available for application, which gives the developer reason to sell quickly.

The 2026 GLS Confirmed List is the largest in over a decade, so buyers have alternatives.

At 1,056 units, the developer needs strong first-weekend volume.

## Why it may land at the higher end

Chuan Park is effectively sold out, so there is little competing new stock on Lorong Chuan.

Thomson Reserve's 90% launch take-up at about $2,900 psf shows buyers will pay for transport and schools.

Parcel 1's land rate was near the OCR record.

## Questions about price
What is the One Chuan Grove price?There is no official price list yet. Analysts have put the expected average between about $2,600 psf (PropNex) and $2,850 psf (the top of commentary after the land tenders). At those rates a 1-bedroom of 474 sq ft would cost roughly $1.23m to $1.35m.

How much did the developer pay for the One Chuan Grove land?$703.60m for Parcel 1 at $1,376 psf ppr and $623.91m for Parcel 2 at $1,331 psf ppr, a total of $1,327.51m. Across 979,924 sq ft of GFA, that is $1,355 psf ppr.

Will One Chuan Grove be more expensive than Chuan Park?Probably, on a psf basis. Chuan Park launched at an average of $2,579 psf in November 2024 and was 99% sold at $2,594 psf by October 2026. Most analyst estimates for One Chuan Grove sit above that, though smaller unit sizes could keep total prices comparable.

What is a land-to-launch multiple?It is the average launch price psf divided by the land price psf ppr. Recent examples: The Orie launched at about 2.0 times its land rate and Thomson Reserve at about 2.5 times. One Chuan Grove at $2,600 to $2,850 psf would be 1.9 to 2.1 times.

## What the mix means for you

## The real entry point is the 2-bedroom

With just three 1-bedroom units, almost every buyer will be choosing from 581 sq ft upwards. At the analyst range that is roughly $1.51m to $2.02m for a 2-bedroom. Estimate Check what you can afford.

## Family units are the scarce ones elsewhere

At Thomson Reserve's launch on 30–31 October 2026, every 3- and 4-bedroom sold, along with all 200 two-bedroom + study units. What was left was 123 plain 2-bedrooms and two 5-bedroom suites. Confirmed One Chuan Grove has 555 three- and four-bedroom units, 52.6% of the project, against Thomson Reserve's 41.3%. Expect those to be contested first. Estimate

## Two-bedrooms face the most resale competition

471 two-bedroom units in one project, plus Chuan Park's next door, means many similar units when owners sell after completion. If you buy a 2-bedroom, the study variant, a higher floor or a non-CTE facing will help it stand out.

## The 5-bedroom is rare

27 units at about 1,561 sq ft, reported to come with a private lift. Reported Rare units tend to hold value, but they also carry the largest quantum: roughly $4.06m to $4.45m at the analyst range.

## Seven checks when the floor plans release

Strata area versus usable area. Subtract air-con ledges, planter boxes and voids to compare like with like.

Bedroom dimensions. A 3-bedroom at 807 sq ft will have at least one small room. Check it fits a single bed and a desk.

Facing. The site sits beside the CTE. Identify which stacks face the expressway and which face the low-rise Chiltern estate.

Dumbbell versus long corridor layouts. Dumbbell layouts separate bedrooms for privacy; corridors waste space.

Kitchen type. Open kitchens are common in 2-bedrooms; check whether an enclosed option exists if you cook heavily.

Study and flexi rooms. Confirm windows and ventilation if you plan to use one as a bedroom.

Bin centres, substations and the childcare drop-off. These show on the site plan, not the unit plan.

## Questions about floor plans
What unit types does One Chuan Grove have?One to five bedrooms. The reported mix is 3 one-bedroom, 471 two-bedroom (including study and premium layouts), 315 three-bedroom (including flexi), 240 four-bedroom and 27 five-bedroom units, a total of 1,056.

What are the One Chuan Grove unit sizes?474 sq ft to 1,561 sq ft, according to the developer's project page. By type: about 474 sq ft for 1-bedroom, 581 to 710 sq ft for 2-bedroom, 807 to 1,001 sq ft for 3-bedroom, 1,076 to 1,356 sq ft for 4-bedroom and about 1,561 sq ft for 5-bedroom.

How many 1-bedroom units does One Chuan Grove have?Only 3, according to the reported unit mix. In practice the entry point for most buyers will be the 2-bedroom, from 581 sq ft.

Where can I get the One Chuan Grove floor plans?Official floor plans are released with the sales brochure at the preview, planned for 13 February 2027. Register on this site to receive them on release. Plans circulating earlier as 'indicative' are not the project's plans.

## The neighbourhood, honestly

Lorong Chuan is a settled private enclave: older condominiums such as The Scala and Chiltern Park, the Chiltern landed estate, and the business park at New Tech Park. # Who is developing One Chuan Grove?
URL: https://the-one-chuan-grove.sg/developer/

One Chuan Grove is developed by Chuan Grove Pte Ltd, owned 65% by Sing Holdings Residential and 35% by Sunway Developments. The partners won both Chuan Grove parcels in 2025 and are building them as a single project.

Short answer
Chuan Grove Pte Ltd: Sing Holdings Residential 65%, Sunway Developments 35%. Sing Holdings is an SGX-listed Singapore developer founded in 1964; Sunway is a Malaysian conglomerate active in Singapore residential for two decades.

Confirmed URA, LTA, filings, major pressReported Preliminary or third-party, may changeEstimate Analyst range or our arithmetic

## The joint venture Confirmed

 | Developer entity | Chuan Grove Pte Ltd 
 | Sing Holdings Residential | 65% (subsidiary of Sing Holdings Ltd, SGX Mainboard) 
 | Sunway Developments | 35% (subsidiary of Sunway Bhd, Bursa Malaysia; now reported as Sunway MCL) 
 | Land committed | $1,327.51m for two parcels 

## Sing Holdings

Founded in 1964 and listed on the SGX Mainboard, Sing Holdings is a mid-sized developer that typically runs one or two projects at a time. Its most recent completion, the North Gaia executive condominium, handed over in 2025 and lifted FY2025 profit attributable to shareholders to $142.3m. Management told shareholders in February 2026 that the Chuan Grove launch would be its focus for the next year.

## What that means for buyers

A developer with one major project has every incentive to get it right, and also limited capacity to absorb a slow sale. Expect pricing designed to move volume early.

## Sunway

Sunway's Singapore portfolio includes The Continuum, Terra Hills and Novo Place. Chuan Grove expanded its Singapore pipeline to six projects. This is the first project Sing Holdings and Sunway have developed together.

Which main contractor is building it, and which of their completed projects can I visit?

Its recent North Gaia executive condominium handed over in 2025, driving a FY2025 profit of $142.3m. Reliability for a specific project is best judged by checking its completed projects in person.

# One Chuan Grove review: worth it?
URL: https://the-one-chuan-grove.sg/review/

Verdict: shortlist it for family own-stay; wait for the price list before treating it as an investment. The location and demand are proven. The price, and how it compares with Chuan Park and the rest of the 2026 supply, is the open question.

Verdict

## Strong address, unproven price

One Chuan Grove gets the hard-to-replicate things right: a Circle Line station within about 400 m, two interchanges one stop away, a primary school catchment families compete for, and a large enough site for full facilities. Chuan Park, next door, sold 99% of its 916 homes. What remains unknown is whether the developer prices it close to Chuan Park's $2,594 psf average, or closer to $2,850 psf. At the lower end it is a solid buy for families. At the upper end, the case rests on future appreciation that a larger local supply could slow.

Confirmed URA, LTA, filings, major pressReported Preliminary or third-party, may changeEstimate Analyst range or our arithmetic

## Jack's price bands

Decided before the price list is released, so the verdict can't be fitted to the prices afterwards.

Good value≤ $2,650 psfAt or below what Chuan Park units have changed hands for over the past year, for a project that completes about two years later.

Fair$2,650 – 2,800Up to about 5% above Chuan Park's recent prices. A reasonable premium for newer stock and a larger site.

Stretch> $2,800 psfClose to Thomson Reserve's ≈$2,900 launch average. The upside from here relies on the market rising.

Project-average psf. Smaller units always carry a higher psf, so judge a 2-bedroom against 2-bedrooms. Basis: Chuan Park resale and sub-sale caveats centred around $2,650–2,700 psf over the 12 months to August 2026 (URA data via ShiokNest) Reported; Chuan Park 99% sold at an average $2,594 psf Confirmed. Bands are Jack's own framework Estimate.

## Buy, wait or skip

## Buy, if all of these hold
The launch average lands in the Good or Fair band
You will live in it or hold it for at least 5 years
Your stack does not face the CTE, or it is priced lower to reflect that
Your total debt repayments stay at or below 45% of income

## Wait or skip, if any of these hold
The average lands in the Stretch band: watch later phases and Chuan Park resales first
You need to sell soon after completion, when Chuan Park resales and a possible third Chuan Grove launch compete
You would be at the 55% TDSR limit
The only unit left in your budget is a plain 2-bedroom facing the expressway

## Pros and cons

## For

≈400 m to Lorong Chuan MRT (CC14), on a Circle Line that now runs a full loop

One stop to Serangoon (NEL) and Bishan (NSL) interchanges

Reported primary schools within 1 km include St. Gabriel's and CHIJ Our Lady of Good Counsel

Demand proven next door: Chuan Park 99% sold

326,640 sq ft site with shops and a childcare centre on site

Full unit range from 1 to 5 bedrooms

## Against

Likely to price at or above Chuan Park psf

About 930 more homes possible on the new Chuan Grove Reserve List site

CTE noise for expressway-facing stacks

1,056 units means more identical units at resale

Completion around 2030; the lease runs from 2025

Preliminary sizes for 3-bedrooms look compact

## Eight risks and how to manage each

 | | Risk | What could happen | How to manage it
 | Entry price | Launch at $2,800+ psf leaves less upside than Chuan Park buyers had | Compare total price for the same usable area against Chuan Park resale asking prices
 | Local supply | URA's Reserve List site (≈930 homes) is triggered and launches by 2028–2029 | Prefer layouts and stacks that are scarce: 3-bed and 4-bed, non-CTE facing
 | Regional supply | 2026 GLS Confirmed List is 9,320 homes, over 50% above the 10-year average | Plan to hold for at least five to seven years
 | Resale competition | Many owners selling similar units at the same time after completion | Avoid the most common unit type at the lowest floors
 | Noise and facing | Expressway noise for some blocks | Visit at peak hour; check the site plan orientation
 | Preliminary specs | Unit counts, sizes and facilities may change | Rely only on the sales brochure and the S&P agreement
 | Interest rates | Higher rates raise monthly instalments during the build | Stress-test at 1 percentage point above your bank's quote
 | Policy | Changes to ABSD, LTV or the TDSR | Lock in your financing position before booking day

Supply figures: URA and MND, 2H2026 GLS Programme and the 27 October 2026 Reserve List release.

## Good fit

Families already in Serangoon, Bishan or Ang Mo Kio who want to stay near schools and grandparents

HDB upgraders who commute on the Circle, North East or North-South Lines

Landed owners in Chiltern or Serangoon Gardens right-sizing nearby

## Consider passing

Investors looking for a quick resale at TOP

Buyers who need a guaranteed school place (the address is not issued yet)

Anyone stretched to the TDSR limit at launch prices

## Questions about this review
Is One Chuan Grove a good investment?It depends on the launch price. The location fundamentals are strong and Chuan Park's sell-out shows demand. The risks are a price at or above Chuan Park, about 930 more homes possible on a nearby Reserve List site, and a heavy 2026 land supply. It is stronger as an own-stay family home than as a short-term investment.

What are the pros of One Chuan Grove?About 400 m to Lorong Chuan MRT on the completed Circle Line, one stop to two interchanges, a strong primary school catchment, a large site with full facilities, and proven demand from Chuan Park next door.

What are the cons of One Chuan Grove?Likely pricing above Chuan Park, CTE noise for some stacks, a large unit count that means more resale competition, a possible third Chuan Grove project nearby, and completion around 2030, which leaves about 95 years of lease at handover.

Who should buy One Chuan Grove?Families who want to stay in the Serangoon, Bishan or Ang Mo Kio area, HDB upgraders who value the Circle Line, and landed owners right-sizing nearby. It suits buyers planning to hold for at least five to seven years.

# One Chuan Grove vs Chuan Park
URL: https://the-one-chuan-grove.sg/vs-chuan-park/

Chuan Park is the closest comparable to One Chuan Grove: same enclave, same MRT station, launched in November 2024 and now 99% sold at about $2,594 psf. One Chuan Grove is larger, completes later and is expected to price higher.

Short answer
Same neighbourhood, same station. Chuan Park: earlier completion, shorter MRT walk, nearly sold out. One Chuan Grove: full choice of units in February 2027, newer lease, likely higher psf.

Confirmed URA, LTA, filings, major pressReported Preliminary or third-party, may changeEstimate Analyst range or our arithmetic

## Side by side

 | | | One Chuan Grove | Chuan Park
 | Developer | Sing Holdings & Sunway JV | Kingsford Group
 | Homes | 1,056 | 916
 | Land source | Two GLS parcels, 2025 | En bloc of the former Chuan Park, 2022 ($890m)
 | Land rate | $1,355 psf ppr | —
 | Launch | Expected Feb 2027 | Nov 2024
 | Price, psf | $2,600 – $2,850 (estimate) | $2,579 launch, $2,594 avg (99% sold)
 | Lorong Chuan MRT | ≈ 400 m | Beside the station
 | Completion | ≈ 2030 | ≈ end-2028 (reported)
 | Units left | All | ≈ 1%

Chuan Park figures: EdgeProp, 8 Jul 2025 and 27 Oct 2026. Chuan Park completion is reported by marketing agents and should be confirmed.

## How to decide

## Choose Chuan Park if
You want keys around two years earlier.
The shortest possible MRT walk matters most.
You find a resale or remaining unit priced at or below One Chuan Grove's eventual list for the same usable area.

## Choose One Chuan Grove if
You want the full choice of stacks and floors on booking day.
A later completion suits your HDB sale, MOP or savings timeline.
You prefer the progressive payment schedule's longer runway.

Either way, compare usable area and total price, not psf. Chuan Park's sizes include air-con ledges, which inflates its strata area against a usable-space comparison.

## Questions
Should I buy One Chuan Grove or Chuan Park?Chuan Park is nearly sold out at about $2,594 psf, sits right beside Lorong Chuan MRT and completes earlier. One Chuan Grove will have fresh stock to choose from, a newer lease and a later completion, likely at a higher psf. If you need a home sooner or want the shortest MRT walk, look at Chuan Park resale or remaining units; if you want first pick of stacks and can wait to about 2030, wait for One Chuan Grove's price list.

How far apart are One Chuan Grove and Chuan Park?They are in the same Lorong Chuan enclave and share Lorong Chuan MRT (CC14). Sunway described Chuan Park as about 200 m from the Chuan Grove site.

# Chuan Grove: three land parcels, one project so far
URL: https://the-one-chuan-grove.sg/chuan-grove-gls/

“Chuan Grove” now refers to three Government Land Sales parcels off Lorong Chuan. Parcels 1 and 2 were sold in 2025 and are being built as One Chuan Grove. A third, larger parcel was placed on the Reserve List on 27 October 2026 and has not been sold.

Short answer
Parcels 1 and 2 = One Chuan Grove (1,056 homes, launching Feb 2027). The third parcel = an unsold Reserve List site of about 930 homes, released 27 Oct 2026.

Confirmed URA, LTA, filings, major pressReported Preliminary or third-party, may changeEstimate Analyst range or our arithmetic

## All three Chuan Grove parcels

 | | | Parcel 1 | Parcel 2 | Reserve List site
 | Status | Sold, Jul 2025 | Sold, Sep 2025 | Available for application, 27 Oct 2026
 | Site area | 170,409 sq ft | 156,231 sq ft | 341,170 sq ft (31,695.7 sqm)
 | Max GFA | 511,232 sq ft | 468,693 sq ft | 852,932 sq ft (79,240 sqm)
 | Estimated homes | ≈ 555 | ≈ 505 | ≈ 930
 | Winning bid | $703.60m · $1,376 psf ppr | $623.91m · $1,331 psf ppr | —
 | Bids received | 7 | 5 | —
 | Becomes | One Chuan Grove | One Chuan Grove | Not yet known

 Confirmed
Sources: URA, EdgeProp, 99.co, Sing Holdings SGX filing.

## Who bid for Parcels 1 and 2

Parcel 1 drew seven bids; City Developments came second at $1,282 psf ppr and Sim Lian third. Parcel 2 drew five, with COLI (Singapore) second at $1,293 psf ppr. All five Parcel 2 bidders had also bid for Parcel 1. The tight spread among the top bids suggests developers broadly agreed on the area's value. Confirmed

## What the third site means for One Chuan Grove buyers

A Reserve List site is sold only when a developer commits to a minimum price the government accepts. Analysts quoted by EdgeProp do not expect a trigger soon, and expect developers to watch One Chuan Grove's sales first. Confirmed

If it is triggered and tendered in 2027, a launch would typically follow 12 to 18 months later. That could put another 900-plus homes on sale around 2028–2029, close to One Chuan Grove's completion. Buyers who may want to sell soon after completion should weigh that. Buyers holding for the long term are less affected. Estimate

## Questions
What is the Chuan Grove GLS site?Chuan Grove refers to Government Land Sales parcels off Lorong Chuan in District 19. Two were sold in 2025 and became One Chuan Grove. A third, larger parcel of 31,695.7 sqm was released on the Reserve List on 27 October 2026 and remains unsold.

Will the new Chuan Grove Reserve List site be sold?Only if a developer submits a minimum price the government accepts. Analysts from Huttons and PropNex said in October 2026 they do not expect it to be triggered soon, partly because One Chuan Grove adds substantial supply first.

How many homes could the Chuan Grove Reserve List site yield?About 930, according to URA. The site has a maximum GFA of 79,240 sqm and a 99-year lease.

Is Chuan Grove Residences the same as One Chuan Grove?Yes. Chuan Grove Residences was an informal name used before the project was officially named One Chuan Grove.

## Questions
How is buyer's stamp duty calculated for One Chuan Grove?Residential BSD is tiered: 1% on the first $180,000, 2% on the next $180,000, 3% on the next $640,000, 4% on the next $500,000, 5% on the next $1.5m and 6% above $3m. ABSD is added for second and subsequent properties and for non-citizens.

How much cash do I need on booking day?The 5% option fee on booking day. Within the following weeks you pay a further 15% when exercising the S&P (at least 5% of the price in cash), plus stamp duties within 14 days of exercising.

## How the preview and booking day work

Before 13 FebRegister and get loan approval in principleKnow your ceiling before you see the price list. Check your budget.

13–23 FebVisit the showflatSee the two or three model units, the site model and the price list. Ask for the full price list, not just the "from" prices.

During the previewSubmit an expression of interestUsually with a cheque. At Thomson Reserve around 3,200 cheques were collected for 1,268 homes. Confirmed

27 FebBooking dayBuyers are called in ballot order. You choose a unit from what is left and pay the 5% option fee.

Within 8 weeksExercise the S&PPay the balance of the 20% downpayment, then stamp duty within 14 days of exercising.

## What to bring to the showflat

NRIC or passport for everyone who will be on the title
Your bank's in-principle approval letter

A cheque book for the expression of interest
A ranked list of 5 to 6 units you'd accept, not just one

Your stamp duty position: first home, second home with ABSD, or sell-first

## Five questions to ask at the showflat

Which stacks face the CTE, and what noise mitigation is planned?

Where is the pedestrian gate closest to Lorong Chuan MRT, and how long is the walk from each block?

What is the strata area of air-con ledges and planters in the unit I want?

Which units are released in the first phase, and will prices rise for later phases?

What is the expected maintenance fee per share value?

## Questions about the showflat
Where is the One Chuan Grove showflat?One marketing site reports it on Youngberg Terrace, near Woodleigh MRT. The developer has not published the address, and showflats are usually off-site. Confirm the address when your appointment is set.

When does the One Chuan Grove showflat open?The preview is planned from Saturday 13 February 2027, with appointments reported to run to 23 February. Booking day is planned for Saturday 27 February 2027. Both dates are preliminary.

Do I need an appointment to visit the One Chuan Grove showflat?Yes. New-launch previews in Singapore run by appointment, and slots on the first weekend fill fastest. Register to be offered a slot.

Can I buy a unit at the One Chuan Grove preview?Not during the preview itself. You view the showflat and price list, then submit an expression of interest, usually with a cheque. Units are selected on booking day in ballot order.

Five blocks: one 24-storey and four 27-storey. 1,056 homes, 7 shops and a childcare centre on a 326,640 sq ft site. The official site plan is released with the brochure.

## What the layout means for buyers

## Large site, more space between blocks

Five blocks on 326,640 sq ft is a lower density than many recent city-fringe launches. Expect more room for the landscape deck and longer distances between some blocks and the MRT gate.

## Shops and childcare on site

Daily conveniences and a childcare centre within the development suit young families. The trade-off is weekday drop-off traffic near the childcare entrance. Check which block sits closest to it.

## The CTE edge

The site runs alongside the Central Expressway. Units facing it will hear traffic. Units facing the low-rise Chiltern estate or Chuan Lane Park should be quieter and keep a more open view.

## Questions about the site plan

See the facilities page for the full list.

Does One Chuan Grove have shops?Yes. Seven shop units of about 409 sq ft each, plus a childcare centre, according to the developer.

How big is the One Chuan Grove site?326,640 sq ft (about 30,346 sqm), made up of two adjacent Government Land Sales parcels amalgamated into one site.

# One Chuan Grove vs Thomson Reserve
URL: https://the-one-chuan-grove.sg/vs-thomson-reserve/

Thomson Reserve sold 90.1% of its 1,268 homes at launch, including every 3- and 4-bedroom. One Chuan Grove, launching in February 2027, is the next large launch near a Circle Line station, and 52.6% of its homes are 3- or 4-bedroom.

Short answer
If you missed a family-sized unit at Thomson Reserve, One Chuan Grove is the closest next chance: a mature estate, a Circle Line station about 400 m away, and 555 three- and four-bedroom units. Its 3-bedrooms are smaller, so compare total price for the space you need.

Confirmed URA, LTA, filings, major pressReported Preliminary or third-party, may changeEstimate Analyst range or our arithmetic

## What Thomson Reserve's launch tells One Chuan Grove buyers

## Family units go first

All 350 three-bedroom and 174 four-bedroom units at Thomson Reserve sold over the launch period, as did all 200 two-bedroom + study units. The 125 left were 123 plain 2-bedrooms and two 5-bedroom suites. Confirmed

## Demand ran well ahead of supply

About 3,200 cheques were collected for 1,268 homes. If One Chuan Grove draws a similar ratio, many registrants will leave booking day without the unit they wanted. Rank several acceptable units in advance. Estimate

## Smaller layouts mean lower quantum

One Chuan Grove's 3-bedrooms start at 807 sq ft against Thomson Reserve's 947 sq ft. At $2,725 psf, an 807 sq ft unit is about $2.20m; Thomson Reserve's cheapest 3-bedroom started at $2.503m. Estimate The smaller unit costs less, but check that the room sizes work for your family.

## Who should look at which

## One Chuan Grove suits
Families who missed a 3- or 4-bedroom at Thomson Reserve
Buyers tied to Serangoon, Bishan or Ang Mo Kio schools and family
Circle Line commuters

## Thomson Reserve resale or remaining units suit
Buyers who want larger room sizes per bedroom count
Thomson-East Coast Line commuters
Those happy with a 2-bedroom, the type still available

## Questions
Is One Chuan Grove similar to Thomson Reserve?Both are large 99-year leasehold launches near an MRT station in a mature estate. Thomson Reserve (1,268 homes, D20) launched in October 2026 and sold 90.1%. One Chuan Grove (1,056 homes, D19) launches in February 2027 with a larger share of 3- and 4-bedroom units.

Will One Chuan Grove be cheaper than Thomson Reserve?Possibly on a psf basis. Thomson Reserve averaged about $2,900 psf at launch. Analysts estimate $2,600 to $2,850 psf for One Chuan Grove, though its land cost per square foot was higher.

I missed Thomson Reserve. Should I consider One Chuan Grove?If you wanted a 3- or 4-bedroom near the MRT in a mature estate, yes. Those sold out at Thomson Reserve, and One Chuan Grove has 555 of them. Compare the price list when it is released.

One Chuan Grove's reported facilities include a 50 m lap pool, a tennis court, two padel courts, two golf simulators and a 1,300 sq ft gym, with 7 shops and a childcare centre on site. The list was released in October 2026; the sales brochure will confirm it.

Short answer
About 20 facilities across pools, courts, fitness and dining, plus 7 shops and a childcare centre. Shops and childcare are confirmed by the developer; the rest is reported from marketing sites and may change.

## What stands out

## Five racquet courts is unusual

One tennis court, two padel courts and two pickleball or badminton courts is a larger racquet offering than most recent launches. With 1,056 households, courts are the facility that gets booked out first, so more of them matters.

## An indoor air-conditioned court

Singapore's heat and rain make outdoor courts unusable for much of the day. An indoor, air-conditioned badminton and pickleball court is usable year-round.

## What it costs you

More facilities mean higher upkeep. The cost is spread across 1,056 homes, which helps, but ask for the estimated maintenance fee per share value at the showflat before deciding. The fee has not been published.

## Check where they sit

Courts and pavilions are noisy in the evening. When the site plan is released, check which stacks overlook the courts and the pool deck, and which face away.

## Questions about facilities
What facilities does One Chuan Grove have?Reported facilities include a 50 m lap pool, spa and relaxation pools, hot and cold baths, a steam room, a tennis court, two padel courts, pickleball and badminton courts, two golf simulators, a 1,300 sq ft gym, Pilates and yoga studios, an 800 m jogging path, private dining rooms and four gourmet pavilions. The list was released in October 2026 and should be confirmed against the sales brochure.

Does One Chuan Grove have a tennis court?Yes, one tennis court is on the reported facilities list, along with two padel courts and both outdoor and indoor pickleball courts.

How long is the One Chuan Grove swimming pool?The reported lap pool is 50 m.

Does One Chuan Grove have a childcare centre?Yes. The developer's project page confirms one childcare centre, reported at about 10,000 sq ft, plus 7 shops.

# Schools near One Chuan Grove

Short answer
St. Gabriel's Primary, CHIJ Our Lady of Good Counsel, Yangzheng Primary and Kuo Chuan Presbyterian Primary are reported within 1 km. Do not rely on this for Primary 1 registration until you have checked the official address on MOE SchoolFinder.

Confirmed URA, LTA, filings, major pressReported Preliminary or third-party, may changeEstimate Analyst range or our arithmetic

## Schools by distance band Reported

Reported by 99.co, PropNex and LiveFree. Bands are measured by MOE from the block's address, which has not been issued. | | Band | Schools
 | Primary, reported within 1 km | St. Gabriel's Primary School · CHIJ Our Lady of Good Counsel · Yangzheng Primary School · Kuo Chuan Presbyterian Primary School
 | Primary, reported within 1–2 km | Zhonghua Primary School · Townsville Primary School · First Toa Payoh Primary School · Guangyang Primary School · Pei Chun Public School · Maris Stella High School (Primary)
 | Secondary, reported within 2 km | Zhonghua Secondary School · Kuo Chuan Presbyterian Secondary School · Peicai Secondary School · St. Gabriel's Secondary School · Beatty Secondary School
 | Junior college & international | Nanyang Junior College (short walk) · Australian International School (across the road) · Stamford American International School

## How Primary 1 distance priority works

Distance is measured from your block, not the condo gate, to the school's boundary. On a 326,640 sq ft site, one block can fall inside 1 km while another falls outside.

Priority applies within a phase. Children living within 1 km are placed before those at 1 to 2 km, then beyond 2 km, among applicants in the same phase.

Oversubscribed phases go to a ballot within the distance band. Being within 1 km improves the odds; it does not guarantee a place.

You must live there. MOE expects the child to live at the address used for registration for at least 30 months from the start of the registration exercise.

Rules summarised from MOE; check MOE for the current exercise. One Chuan Grove completes around 2030, so it suits children who will register for Primary 1 after that.

## What to do if a school is your reason for buying

Wait for the official address and block numbers, then check each block on MOE SchoolFinder.

Work back from your child's registration year. With completion around 2030, a child born in 2024 or later fits the timeline.

Have a second-choice school within 1 km. This area has four.

## Questions about schools
Which primary schools are within 1 km of One Chuan Grove?Four are reported within 1 km: St. Gabriel's Primary, CHIJ Our Lady of Good Counsel, Yangzheng Primary and Kuo Chuan Presbyterian Primary. Distances must be confirmed on MOE SchoolFinder once the project's official address is issued.

Does living at One Chuan Grove guarantee a Primary 1 place?No. Living within 1 km gives priority within each registration phase, not a guaranteed place. If a phase is oversubscribed, MOE ballots among applicants in the same distance band.

Is One Chuan Grove near Nanyang Junior College?Yes. PropNex's research describes Nanyang Junior College as a short walk from the site.

Are there international schools near One Chuan Grove?Yes. The Australian International School is across the road, and Stamford American International School is nearby at Woodleigh.

# One Chuan Grove: questions and answers
URL: https://the-one-chuan-grove.sg/faq/

Direct answers to what buyers ask most about One Chuan Grove, each consistent with the sourced figures on the rest of this guide.

If I walk into the showflat on my own, who serves me?Usually a salesperson from one of the marketing agencies the developer has appointed. You pay the same price either way. The difference is whether the person helping you has looked at the numbers for your situation before you arrive.

Is this the official One Chuan Grove website?No. This is an independent guide by Jack Leow, a CEA-registered property agent (R074023I) with PropNex Realty. The developer's own project page is on singholdings.com. Many sites calling themselves 'official' are run by agents too; check the CEA number in their footer.

Do I pay more if I buy One Chuan Grove through an agent?No. Singapore developers sell new launch units at the same list price whether you go direct or through an agent, and the developer pays the agent's commission. Buyers pay no agent fee.

Can I get a better price going direct to the developer?No. Launch prices and any early-bird discounts are set by the developer and apply to every buyer in that release, whether they come direct or through an agent.

What is One Chuan Grove?One Chuan Grove is a 99-year leasehold condominium of 1,056 homes at Chuan Grove, off Lorong Chuan in District 19, Singapore. It is built on two adjacent Government Land Sales parcels that the developer amalgamated into one site of 326,640 sq ft.

Is One Chuan Grove the same as the Chuan Grove GLS site?Yes, for the two parcels awarded in 2025. One Chuan Grove sits on Chuan Grove Parcel 1 (awarded July 2025) and Parcel 2 (awarded September 2025). It is not the separate 930-unit Chuan Grove Reserve List site URA released on 27 October 2026, which has not been sold.

When does One Chuan Grove launch?The launch is expected in February 2027. Third-party reports of the developer's preliminary plan put the preview on 13 February 2027 and booking day on 27 February 2027. The developer has not published a confirmed date.

How much will One Chuan Grove cost?No price list has been released. Analyst estimates range from about $2,600 to $2,850 psf, which would put a 474 sq ft 1-bedroom at roughly $1.23m to $1.35m and an 807 to 1,001 sq ft 3-bedroom at roughly $2.10m to $2.85m.

Who is the developer of One Chuan Grove?Chuan Grove Pte Ltd, a joint venture owned 65% by Sing Holdings Residential and 35% by Sunway Developments, according to the companies' stock exchange filings.

Which MRT station is nearest to One Chuan Grove?Lorong Chuan MRT (CC14) on the Circle Line, within about 400 m. Serangoon (CC13/NE12) and Bishan (CC15/NS17) interchanges are one stop away in either direction.

What facilities does One Chuan Grove have?Reported facilities include a 50 m lap pool, spa and relaxation pools, hot and cold baths, a steam room, a tennis court, two padel courts, pickleball and badminton courts, two golf simulators, a 1,300 sq ft gym, Pilates and yoga studios, an 800 m jogging path, private dining rooms and four gourmet pavilions. The list was released in October 2026 and should be confirmed against the sales brochure.

Does One Chuan Grove have a tennis court?Yes, one tennis court is on the reported facilities list, along with two padel courts and both outdoor and indoor pickleball courts.

Which primary schools are within 1 km of One Chuan Grove?Four are reported within 1 km: St. Gabriel's Primary, CHIJ Our Lady of Good Counsel, Yangzheng Primary and Kuo Chuan Presbyterian Primary. Distances must be confirmed on MOE SchoolFinder once the project's official address is issued.

Does living at One Chuan Grove guarantee a Primary 1 place?No. Living within 1 km gives priority within each registration phase, not a guaranteed place. If a phase is oversubscribed, MOE ballots among applicants in the same distance band.

How many One Chuan Grove units are still available?All 1,056. Sales have not started. Booking day is planned for 27 February 2027, and this page will be updated from that day.

Where is the One Chuan Grove showflat?One marketing site reports it on Youngberg Terrace, near Woodleigh MRT. The developer has not published the address, and showflats are usually off-site. Confirm the address when your appointment is set.

When does the One Chuan Grove showflat open?The preview is planned from Saturday 13 February 2027, with appointments reported to run to 23 February. Booking day is planned for Saturday 27 February 2027. Both dates are preliminary.

How many 1-bedroom units does One Chuan Grove have?Only 3, according to the reported unit mix. In practice the entry point for most buyers will be the 2-bedroom, from 581 sq ft.

What facilities does One Chuan Grove have?Reported facilities include a 50 m lap pool, a tennis court, two padel courts, pickleball and badminton courts, two golf simulators, a 1,300 sq ft gym, studios, private dining rooms and four gourmet pavilions, plus 7 shops and a childcare centre. See the facilities page for the full list.

I missed Thomson Reserve. Should I consider One Chuan Grove?If you wanted a 3- or 4-bedroom near the MRT in a mature estate, yes. Those sold out at Thomson Reserve, and One Chuan Grove has 555 of them. Compare the price list when it is released.

Is the One Chuan Grove e-brochure available?Not yet. Developers in Singapore usually release the sales brochure and floor plans at the preview, planned for 13 February 2027. Register to receive it on release.

When will the One Chuan Grove price list be released?Price lists for Singapore new launches are usually released at or just before the preview. Expect it around the preview in mid-February 2027.

How much is the booking fee for One Chuan Grove?Under Singapore's Progressive Payment Scheme the buyer pays 5% of the price when the Option to Purchase is granted on booking day, then 15% (less the 5%) on exercising the Sale and Purchase Agreement within 8 weeks.

When will One Chuan Grove be completed?Construction started in the second half of 2026. A typical build of about four years points to completion around 2030; project signboard information reported by third parties gives an expected completion date of 16 July 2030.

How much did the developer pay for the One Chuan Grove land?$703.60m for Parcel 1 at $1,376 psf ppr and $623.91m for Parcel 2 at $1,331 psf ppr, a total of $1,327.51m. Across 979,924 sq ft of GFA, that is $1,355 psf ppr.

Will One Chuan Grove be more expensive than Chuan Park?Probably, on a psf basis. Chuan Park launched at an average of $2,579 psf in November 2024 and was 99% sold at $2,594 psf by October 2026. Most analyst estimates for One Chuan Grove sit above that, though smaller unit sizes could keep total prices comparable.

What is a land-to-launch multiple?It is the average launch price psf divided by the land price psf ppr. Recent examples: The Orie launched at about 2.0 times its land rate and Thomson Reserve at about 2.5 times. One Chuan Grove at $2,600 to $2,850 psf would be 1.9 to 2.1 times.

What are the One Chuan Grove unit sizes?474 sq ft to 1,561 sq ft, according to the developer's project page. By type: about 474 sq ft for 1-bedroom, 581 to 710 sq ft for 2-bedroom, 807 to 1,001 sq ft for 3-bedroom, 1,076 to 1,356 sq ft for 4-bedroom and about 1,561 sq ft for 5-bedroom.

How many 1-bedroom units does One Chuan Grove have?Only 3, according to the reported unit mix. In practice the entry point for most buyers will be the 2-bedroom, from 581 sq ft.

Where can I get the One Chuan Grove floor plans?Official floor plans are released with the sales brochure at the preview, planned for 13 February 2027. Register on this site to receive them on release. Plans circulating earlier as 'indicative' are not the project's plans.

Is One Chuan Grove near a Cross Island Line station?No. The nearest station is Lorong Chuan on the Circle Line. Some websites wrongly refer to a 'Chuan Park MRT' on the Cross Island Line; there is no such station serving the site.

Which primary schools are within 1 km of One Chuan Grove?Schools reported within about 1 km include St. Gabriel's Primary, Kuo Chuan Presbyterian Primary, CHIJ Our Lady of Good Counsel and Yangzheng Primary. Confirm distances on MOE SchoolFinder once the official address is issued; Primary 1 eligibility is measured from the home address.

What malls are near One Chuan Grove?NTP+ at New Tech Park is next to the site. NEX at Serangoon and Junction 8 at Bishan are each one MRT stop away.

Is Sing Holdings a reliable developer?Sing Holdings was founded in 1964 and is listed on the SGX Mainboard. Its recent North Gaia executive condominium handed over in 2025, driving a FY2025 profit of $142.3m. Reliability for a specific project is best judged by checking its completed projects in person.

What has Sunway developed in Singapore?Sunway's Singapore projects include The Continuum, Terra Hills and Novo Place. Sunway Developments is a subsidiary of Malaysia's Sunway Bhd and has since been reported as Sunway MCL.

Is One Chuan Grove a good investment?It depends on the launch price. The location fundamentals are strong and Chuan Park's sell-out shows demand. The risks are a price at or above Chuan Park, about 930 more homes possible on a nearby Reserve List site, and a heavy 2026 land supply. It is stronger as an own-stay family home than as a short-term investment.

What are the pros of One Chuan Grove?About 400 m to Lorong Chuan MRT on the completed Circle Line, one stop to two interchanges, a strong primary school catchment, a large site with full facilities, and proven demand from Chuan Park next door.

What are the cons of One Chuan Grove?Likely pricing above Chuan Park, CTE noise for some stacks, a large unit count that means more resale competition, a possible third Chuan Grove project nearby, and completion around 2030, which leaves about 95 years of lease at handover.

Who should buy One Chuan Grove?Families who want to stay in the Serangoon, Bishan or Ang Mo Kio area, HDB upgraders who value the Circle Line, and landed owners right-sizing nearby. It suits buyers planning to hold for at least five to seven years.

Should I buy One Chuan Grove or Chuan Park?Chuan Park is nearly sold out at about $2,594 psf, sits right beside Lorong Chuan MRT and completes earlier. One Chuan Grove will have fresh stock to choose from, a newer lease and a later completion, likely at a higher psf. If you need a home sooner or want the shortest MRT walk, look at Chuan Park resale or remaining units; if you want first pick of stacks and can wait to about 2030, wait for One Chuan Grove's price list.

Will the new Chuan Grove Reserve List site be sold?Only if a developer submits a minimum price the government accepts. Analysts from Huttons and PropNex said in October 2026 they do not expect it to be triggered soon, partly because One Chuan Grove adds substantial supply first.

How much cash do I need on booking day?The 5% option fee on booking day. Within the following weeks you pay a further 15% when exercising the S&P (at least 5% of the price in cash), plus stamp duties within 14 days of exercising.

Not answered here? Ask Jack directly.

# About this guide
URL: https://the-one-chuan-grove.sg/about/

This guide is written by Jack Leow, a CEA-registered property agent with PropNex Realty Pte Ltd. It is independent of the developer and built to the standard of an audit file: every figure sourced, every estimate labelled.

## The author

Jack Leow is a property agent (CEA Reg. R074023I) with PropNex Realty Pte Ltd (CEA Licence L3008022J). Before property, Jack worked in auditing, which shapes how this site is written: claims are traced to a source, and anything that cannot be traced is labelled. Jack also publishes analysis at sellingsgproperty.com.

## Check Jack's licence in 10 seconds

Open the CEA Public Register and enter 8062 1538. Jack's registration (R074023I) and PropNex Realty (L3008022J) will show. If a "developer hotline" number on another site returns an agent, that site is an agent's site too.

## Editorial standards

Three labels. Confirmed (URA, LTA, SGX or Bursa filings, major property press), Reported (developer preliminary information or third-party reports), Estimate (analyst ranges or our arithmetic).

No renderings or logos belonging to the developer are used. No invented testimonials.

No price claims before the developer's list is released, beyond clearly marked estimates.

Corrections are made within one working day and recorded on the fact ledger.

Interest disclosed. Jack is a licensed agent and may be paid by a developer if a buyer he represents purchases a unit. That does not change the facts or the verdicts here; it is why both are sourced.

## Independence
This is not the website of Chuan Grove Pte Ltd, Sing Holdings or Sunway. For the developer's official documents, ask for the sales brochure and S&P agreement at the showflat.


# Privacy policy
URL: https://the-one-chuan-grove.sg/privacy/

What we collect, why, and how to have it removed.

This site is operated by Jack Leow (PropNex Realty Pte Ltd, CEA Licence L3008022J). We follow Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act 2012.

## What we collect
When you register, we collect your name, mobile number, email and the preferences you choose. We do not ask for NRIC numbers.

## How we use it
Only to send One Chuan Grove information you asked for and to respond to your enquiry. We do not sell or share your data with third parties, other than the form host (Netlify) that delivers it to us.

## Do Not Call
By ticking the consent box you agree that we may contact you even if your number is on the DNC Registry. You can withdraw consent at any time.

## Retention and removal
We keep your details for up to 24 months after the project launch, or until you ask us to delete them. Reply to any message from us, or use the enquiry form, to withdraw consent or request deletion.

## Analytics
We may use privacy-friendly, cookie-less analytics to count page views. No advertising trackers are used.
